stories: Once upon a time, a small lighthouse stood on a rock where no ships ever came. Every night it shone anyway, patient and bright. One stormy evening, a lost fishing boat saw the light, turned toward it, and made it safely home. The lighthouse never knew it — but it had been waiting its whole life for exactly that night.
